purpose: Record every repository and query used to look for evidence behind the six open gaps and the four partial ones, and why each candidate was accepted, rejected or left alone. An open gap is only defensible if the search for it is written down.

candidateAdjudication.title: Optimising Spectral Composition in Hydroponic Lettuce Cultivation
candidateAdjudication.why: Four spectra at a constant 200 umol m-2 s-1 and identical photoperiod, with destructive harvest of 252 plants. Exactly the design the gap asked for.
candidateAdjudication.integrity: MD5 verified against the publisher's checksum; 94,162 bytes.

candidateAdjudication.title: Temporal variation of nutrient ratios within hydroponic nutrient solutions
candidateAdjudication.why: Eight ions and EC measured repeatedly over a real crop cycle. Accepted for the concentration and EC requirements; the pre/post-dose labelling is not self-consistent and no pH is present, so no uptake rate in mass terms is derived.

candidateAdjudication.title: Raw data: Temporal variation of nutrient ratios (Food and Energy Security)
candidateAdjudication.why: A second deposit of the same experiment. All five shared sheets are cell-for-cell identical to 17794636, so counting it would turn one trial into two pieces of evidence. Downloaded and compared precisely so the duplicate could be demonstrated rather than assumed.
candidateAdjudication.integrity: MD5 verified; 55,099 bytes; duplicate evidence in the acquisition manifest.

candidateAdjudication.title: EDEN ISS 2020 Telemetry Dataset
candidateAdjudication.why: 97 sensors over a full year of a real space-analogue greenhouse, and not one power, current, voltage or energy channel. Its unit table lists temperature, pressure, CO2, RH, EC, pH, PAR, valve, level, volume and VPD only. A power figure cannot be derived from it, so it cannot answer a gap defined as power draw per fixture.
candidateAdjudication.integrity: Published MD5 a16658d87da5f3d99cbd1c8e60f743e3 verified before the archive was unpacked; the 260 MB expansion was examined and then removed rather than kept.

candidateAdjudication.title: Fertigation of Bell Pepper in a soil-less greenhouse system
candidateAdjudication.why: Bell pepper, and the record is a publication rather than a measurement table.

candidateAdjudication.title: Data_Sheet_1_Light manipulation … antioxidant properties
candidateAdjudication.why: A supplementary data sheet attached to a paper, not an independent measurement table.

candidateAdjudication.title: Image_1_The Effect of Red & Blue Rich LEDs vs Fluorescent Light on Lollo Rosso Lettuce
candidateAdjudication.why: A figure image from a paper. A published figure is not a dataset.

candidateAdjudication.title: Table_1_The Effect of Red & Blue Rich LEDs … (table)
candidateAdjudication.why: A rendered table image from a paper, not machine-readable measurements.

candidateAdjudication.title: VEG-04A/04B
candidateAdjudication.why: Already acquired in an earlier phase and used as a model anchor; it adds nothing new here.

candidateAdjudication.title: VEG-04A/04B microbial plate counts
candidateAdjudication.why: Already the evidence behind the decision-grade mizuna microbial model.

whySomeGapsStayOpen.substrate-water: No open dataset measures water content inside a CEA substrate together with an irrigation schedule and a drainage fraction. Field-soil series exist and are already recorded as adjacent evidence; substituting them would repeat the exact error the gap is held open to avoid.
whySomeGapsStayOpen.imagery: The platform has no imaging pipeline, and the stated requirement is imagery from its own camera geometry. No external dataset can satisfy a self-referential requirement.
whySomeGapsStayOpen.mission-energy: No accessible dataset measures power draw for flight-representative CEA hardware. The one real candidate has no power sensor at all.
whySomeGapsStayOpen.prediction-intervals-independent-coverag: Interval coverage needs independent observations inside the model's declared domain. Both datasets acquired this phase fall outside it on days-after-sowing, root temperature or missing PPFD.
